physiology:
The seat of this code is the solar plexus, the soft hollow under the breastbone where feeling lands before thought does. It is the body's fire pit. Whatever comes near you, a name, a glance, a piece of news, this is the place that catches it first, brightens or darkens, and only afterwards sends word up to the head. It is fitting that the code of clinging fire is housed here. The flame is not a metaphor laid over the body. The body keeps the flame.

The shadow has its floor in this seat. When wanting will not quiet, the solar plexus is where it shows. A low burn that never resolves. A churning under the ribs that no meal settles. The hunger does not stay in the mind; it sits in the centre, where the next breath has to climb over it. Long stretches of that, and the digestion of life itself begins to falter. You stop being able to take things in cleanly. Everything tastes faintly of the same restlessness.

The climb is bodily too. Heat steadies. The churn slows to something more like warmth. You can sit with a desire and feel it without being thrown by it. The fire is still on. It is simply burning at its own pace now, lower down than the story the mind keeps telling about it. Something that used to scorch begins to cook.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Glutamine. Glutamine is the body's most abundant amino acid, and one of its quieter jobs is to carry nitrogen between tissues, picking it up where there is too much and delivering it where it is needed. A constant inner traffic, never finished. Glutamine is also the raw material the body uses to make glutamate, the chemistry of excitation, the spark that lets one nerve cell light the next.

There is a teaching in that. The amino acid the fire code rests on is literally the precursor to the body's spark. The clinging is in the chemistry. So is the way the spark can be carried, moved, put to use, rather than only burned through. The Ring this code belongs to is the Ring of Purification, and purification at this level is not the dousing of the fire. It is the steady relocation of the fuel, atom by atom, to where it is finally useful.

The code runs all the way down to this. A fire that is not a mood but a chemistry, fed and re-fed, in the part of you that has never stopped wanting.
